criticalityPolicy.journey-critical: Identity, access, billing, child evidence, delivery, legal, recovery, or high failure cost. Requires the deepest scorecard and rollout evidence.
criticalityPolicy.supporting: Direct family or public support surface. Requires every applicable hard gate with representative channel evidence.
criticalityPolicy.utility: Operator, development, authoring, reserved, or low-frequency surface. Criticality may reduce breadth, never brand, behavior, accessibility, residue, or production gates.

deliveryStatePolicy.controlled-current: Homa can update it directly and must remove the old identity.
deliveryStatePolicy.revocable-public: Homa must migrate or revoke the public reference and verify its destination and caches.
deliveryStatePolicy.installed-client: Homa records minimum version, update path, adoption, and retirement behavior.
deliveryStatePolicy.delivered-historical: Already delivered copies cannot be recalled; record stop-generation and honest residual status.
deliveryStatePolicy.private-provenance: Original bytes remain access-controlled for lineage, evidence, or legal truth.
